name: lovitations
description: Make your wedding website, digital invitation or save-the-date on Lovitations in the chat, the way the site's start does: your names, date and photo, then choose a style shown with your own names. Plus wedding planning skills: wording, guest list, RSVP follow-up, seating plan, schedule, budget and speeches.

interface.shortDescription: Your wedding website, in the chat
interface.longDescription:
Lovitations makes digital save-the-dates, wedding invitations and wedding websites with a personal link per guest and a live RSVP overview.

**Make your page in the chat.** The same start as on lovitations.nl: your names, your date and a photo of the two of you, then choose your style from the templates, each shown with your own names, date and photo. You get the link to your page and finish it in the Lovitations editor. Making and editing a page is free; you only pay when you publish it.

**Manage it in the chat.** With your page's editor link (and its PIN, if you set one): who is coming, who has not answered, what to tell the caterer, and add or change guests.

**Plan the wedding.** Invitation wording, website texts, a guest list with day and evening guests, RSVP follow-up, a seating plan, a schedule for the day, a budget and speeches, in your language.

Nothing is sent to your guests: you share the links yourself.
defaultPrompt: I want to make our wedding website on Lovitations.
How many guests have answered our invitation so far?
What does a wedding with 50 day guests and 100 evening guests cost?
